title: The Winter of Old Chapel Road
author: Ulyana Quintana
blurb: Sable Delacroix, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
